note: Adapted from the revision by Sands 1965 of the original description by Fuller 1922 (in English); the alate and the soldier are described, with no separate worker; in the original description the species was placed in Tenuirostritermes. The hind tibia length and the mean hind tibia length of the soldier are damaged by the OCR, so only the range is given. The OCR mistook decimal points for hyphens or colons (I-39 is 1.39, 0:79 is 0.79), restored here by order of magnitude; unclear means are not given.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Differs from the other species of the genus and from Rhadinotermes coarctatus in the larger size of both forms, the narrow columnar nasus of the soldier, its weaker cephalic constriction and the antennae tending to 12 segments; the alate has longer wings and 15-segmented antennae. Sands noted that its generic placement remains doubtful.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Supplement to the original description of Fuller 1922: posterior margin of the head capsule behind the eyes nearly a semicircle; compound eyes rather small relative to the head width, eye width index 3.8—4.4, moderately protruding relative to their own diameter; ocelli small, separated from the compound eye by a little more than 1 to nearly 2 times their own minimum diameter; postclypeus extremely strongly inflated, 1.7—1.8 times as wide as long, anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin regularly convex; the posterior cutting edge of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible exposed beyond the second marginal tooth and rather long; female cerci shorter than their basal width, mammilliform. The setae of the vertex are dense, scattered, yellow bristle-like setae of varying length, and the rest of the body has yellow hair-like and bristle-like setae. Measurements (24 individuals, 7 localities, mm): head width (across the eyes) 1.37—1.43 (mean 1.40); maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.31—0.36 (mean 0.34); ocellus 0.09—0.10 × 0.10—0.16 (mean 0.09 × 0.13); ocellus to eye 0.10—0.19 (mean 0.16); pronotum width 1.22—1.40 (mean 1.32); pronotum length 0.71—0.84 (mean 0.80); hind tibia length 1.63—1.79; forewing length 11.50—14.30 (mean 12.71).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Supplement to the original description of Fuller 1922: head setae 1 pair on the vertex, 4 at the tip of the nasus (with sparse shorter setae behind them) and 1—2 more towards the base of the nasus; antennae 12-segmented (6/10 individuals) or 13-segmented. Abdominal tergite setae very short and sparse, longer at the posterior margin; sternite setae more numerous and short, the posterior marginal setae 2—3 times as long as the short ones. Measurements (53 individuals, 16 localities, mm): head length (to the tip of the nasus) 1.43—1.86 (mean 1.59); head width 0.64—0.94 (mean 0.82); head capsule depth 0.43—0.64 (mean 0.57); pronotum width 0.38—0.51 (mean 0.44); pronotum length 0.18—0.28 (mean 0.23); hind tibia length 0.89—1.30.
